# skycloak_cluster_security (Resource)

Edge-security configuration for a cluster: IP allow-listing, rate limiting, WAF, geo-blocking, bot management, and CAPTCHA. A singleton per cluster. When the `captcha` block is omitted, the server's CAPTCHA settings are left untouched. CAPTCHA hostnames are registered via `skycloak_captcha_domain`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_cluster_security" "production" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id

  # Lock the admin console down to the office network.
  ip_access_control = [
    {
      path          = "/admin"
      description   = "Office network only"
      allowed_cidrs = ["203.0.113.0/24"]
    },
  ]

  rate_limiting = {
    enabled    = true
    global_rpm = 60000
    per_ip_rpm = 600
  }

  waf = {
    enabled        = true
    mode           = "block"
    preset         = "owasp_top_10"
    paranoia_level = 1
  }

  geo_blocking = {
    enabled   = true
    mode      = "blocklist"
    countries = ["KP", "RU"]
  }

  bot_management = {
    enabled        = true
    mode           = "block"
    challenge_mode = "javascript"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.

### Optional

- `bot_management` (Attributes) Bot detection and challenges. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bot_management))
- `captcha` (Attributes) Login-flow CAPTCHA challenges. Omit to leave the server's CAPTCHA settings unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--captcha))
- `geo_blocking` (Attributes) Country-based access control. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--geo_blocking))
- `ip_access_control` (Attributes List) Per-path IP allow rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_access_control))
- `rate_limiting` (Attributes) Request-rate ceilings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limiting))
- `waf` (Attributes) Web application firewall. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--waf))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `cluster_id/security`.

<a id="nestedatt--bot_management"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bot_management`

Required:

- `challenge_mode` (String) `none`, `javascript`, or `captcha`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether bot management is enabled.
- `mode` (String) `block` or `detect`.

Optional:

- `blacklisted_agents` (List of String) User-agent regex patterns to always block.
- `whitelisted_agents` (List of String) User-agent regex patterns to always allow.


<a id="nestedatt--captcha"></a>
### Nested Schema for `captcha`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether CAPTCHA challenges are presented.

Optional:

- `enabled_realms` (List of String) Realm IDs where challenges are presented during login.


<a id="nestedatt--geo_blocking"></a>
### Nested Schema for `geo_blocking`

Required:

- `countries` (List of String) ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether geo-blocking is enabled.
- `mode` (String) `allowlist` or `blocklist`.


<a id="nestedatt--ip_access_control"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_access_control`

Required:

- `path` (String) URL path prefix to restrict.

Optional:

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) CIDR ranges to allow.
- `allowed_ips` (List of String) Individual IPs to allow.
- `description` (String) Rule description.


<a id="nestedatt--rate_limiting"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limiting`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether rate limiting is enabled.

Optional:

- `endpoint_limits` (Attributes List) Per-path request limits. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rate_limiting--endpoint_limits))
- `global_rpm` (Number) Global requests-per-minute ceiling.
- `per_ip_rpm` (Number) Per-source-IP requests-per-minute ceiling.

<a id="nestedatt--rate_limiting--endpoint_limits"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rate_limiting.endpoint_limits`

Required:

- `path` (String) URL path.
- `rpm` (Number) Max requests per minute.



<a id="nestedatt--waf"></a>
### Nested Schema for `waf`

Required:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the WAF is enabled.
- `mode` (String) `block` or `detect`.
- `paranoia_level` (Number) Detection sensitivity (1-4).
- `preset` (String) `owasp_top_10`, `full_crs`, or `custom`.

Optional:

- `categories` (Attributes) Active rule categories (required when `preset` is `custom`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--waf--categories))
- `exclusion_paths` (List of String) URL paths exempt from inspection.
- `rule_exclusions` (Attributes List) CRS rules to disable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--waf--rule_exclusions))

<a id="nestedatt--waf--categories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `waf.categories`

Required:

- `cross_site_scripting` (Boolean)
- `data_leakage` (Boolean)
- `java_attacks` (Boolean)
- `local_file_inclusion` (Boolean)
- `php_injection` (Boolean)
- `protocol_attacks` (Boolean)
- `protocol_enforcement` (Boolean)
- `remote_code_execution` (Boolean)
- `remote_file_inclusion` (Boolean)
- `session_fixation` (Boolean)
- `sql_injection` (Boolean)
- `webshell_detection` (Boolean)


<a id="nestedatt--waf--rule_exclusions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `waf.rule_exclusions`

Required:

Optional:
